answer: The timber schedule is applied in kernel and basalt shows each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1572 identities would post 3897 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
